cohort: 1336 symptomatic and asymptomatic term singleton neonates with meconium-stained amniotic fluid
finding: Intrauterine inflammation, fetal hypoxia-ischaemia, and higher α(1)-acid glycoprotein levels are independent variables associated with the development of meconium aspiration syndrome (MAS).
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was initially associated with MAS development but lost significance after adjusting for multiple comparisons.
